project.name: FinLedger Microservices Platform
project.description: Enterprise financial transaction processing system with 12 microservices, immutable double-entry ledger, and PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance.

requirements.title: PCI-DSS Requirement 3: Cardholder Data Protection
requirements.desc: Card numbers (PAN) must be masked, salted, and encrypted with AES-256-GCM; CVV/CVC must never be stored post-authorization.

requirements.title: Mathematical Conservation of Ledger Balances
requirements.desc: Sum of debits must strictly equal sum of credits for every transaction across accounts; zero rounding error.

requirements.title: Strict Idempotency for Payment Authorization
requirements.desc: UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key headers required on all POST /v1/charges endpoints with 24-hour Redis TTL lock.

requirements.title: Sub-50ms Real-time ML Risk Scoring
requirements.desc: Evaluate anomaly score via XGBoost model before gateway dispatch; trigger Step-Up 3DS if score > 0.72.

requirements.title: OFAC & PEP Sanctions Screening
requirements.desc: Synchronous screening of beneficiary and originator names against OFAC SDN list prior to wire release.

requirements.title: pacs.008 & pain.001 Wire Serialization
requirements.desc: Transform interbank clearing messages into ISO 20022 XML formats compliant with FedNow and SEPA.

requirements.title: Real-time Spot FX Rate Lock
requirements.desc: Provide 60-second guaranteed FX rate quotes for cross-border currency exchanges.

requirements.title: End-of-Day Automated Settlement Matcher
requirements.desc: Three-way automated reconciliation between internal ledger, gateway clearing files, and correspondent bank statements.

requirements.title: WORM Append-Only Transaction Ledger
requirements.desc: Cryptographic hash chaining of financial journal entries with HMAC-SHA256 signature blocks.

requirements.title: Zero-Data-Loss Multi-AZ Database Failover
requirements.desc: Synchronous replication across 3 Availability Zones with RPO = 0 and automatic failover under 10 seconds.

requirements.title: Tiered API Rate Limiting & DoS Protection
requirements.desc: Enforce per-client sliding window rate limits (1,000 req/min standard, 10,000 req/min institutional).

requirements.title: Automated ACH Next-Day Payout Batching
requirements.desc: NACHA formatted batch generation with balance verification and return code handling.

requirements.title: Automated Document Verification & Liveness
requirements.desc: Passport/ID card MRZ parsing and biometric selfie comparison with anti-spoofing.

requirements.title: Chargeback Evidence Lifecycle Management
requirements.desc: Automated visa/mastercard chargeback notification routing and PDF evidence pack submission.

requirements.title: FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR)
requirements.desc: Automated drafting of XML SAR filings for transactions exhibiting structuring behavior over $10,000.

blueprintNodes.name: APIGateway
blueprintNodes.desc: High-concurrency reverse proxy terminating mTLS, validating API keys, and enforcing rate limits.

blueprintNodes.name: AuthService
blueprintNodes.desc: OIDC/OAuth2 authentication engine issuing short-lived HMAC-signed JWT tokens and managing mTLS certs.

blueprintNodes.name: PaymentProcessor
blueprintNodes.desc: Core charge orchestrator coordinating authorization, captures, voids, and refunds across acquirers.

blueprintNodes.name: LedgerService
blueprintNodes.desc: Double-entry accounting journal enforcing mathematical debit/credit balance invariance.

blueprintNodes.name: NotificationService
blueprintNodes.desc: Transactional email, SMS webhook, and push notification dispatcher with retry backoff.

blueprintNodes.name: AuditLogger
blueprintNodes.desc: WORM compliant tamper-evident audit ledger writing signed event blocks to immutable S3 storage.

blueprintNodes.name: ReportEngine
blueprintNodes.desc: Financial statement and regulatory compliance reporting service compiling PDF and XBRL exports.

blueprintNodes.name: UserService
blueprintNodes.desc: Account profile, KYC status, organization memberships, and permission registry.

blueprintNodes.name: RiskEngine
blueprintNodes.desc: Low-latency ML inference service scoring transaction fraud risk in under 15 milliseconds.

blueprintNodes.name: ComplianceChecker
blueprintNodes.desc: Automated sanctions screening against OFAC, EU, UN lists and AML transaction monitoring rules.

blueprintNodes.name: DataWarehouse
blueprintNodes.desc: Snowflake/ClickHouse analytics cluster processing aggregated transaction telemetry.

blueprintNodes.name: MessageBroker
blueprintNodes.desc: Apache Kafka enterprise streaming cluster with transactional outbox pattern.

blueprintNodes.name: SettlementEngine
blueprintNodes.desc: Batch clearing, interbank net settlement, and NACHA ACH file generator.

blueprintNodes.name: FXService
blueprintNodes.desc: Real-time foreign exchange pricing engine with Bloomberg/Refinitiv market feeds.

blueprintNodes.name: CloudHSMVault
blueprintNodes.desc: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware security module storing master encryption and tokenization keys.

blueprintNodes.name: PostgreSQLLedgerDB
blueprintNodes.desc: Distributed PostgreSQL cluster with serializable isolation level for account balances.

blueprintNodes.name: RedisClusterCache
blueprintNodes.desc: In-memory distributed lock and idempotency store with sub-millisecond latency.

blueprintNodes.name: CardNetworksDirectRail
blueprintNodes.desc: Direct ISO 8583 socket connection to Visa Direct and Mastercard Send payment networks.

blueprintNodes.name: FedNowInstantRail
blueprintNodes.desc: Federal Reserve instant payment rail integration for 24/7 real-time gross settlement.

blueprintNodes.name: TreasuryOFACFeed
blueprintNodes.desc: Automated hourly ingest of US Treasury Specially Designated Nationals list.

blueprintNodes.name: S3ObjectLockGlacier
blueprintNodes.desc: WORM storage bucket with 7-year regulatory retention compliance policy.

codeFindings.desc: CWE-312: Cleartext storage of primary account number (PAN) in debug diagnostic log.
CWE-89: SQL Injection via unparameterized account_id in reconciliation batch search.
CWE-798: Static test cryptographic private key embedded directly in source code.
CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery on internal wire approval webhook callback.
CWE-362: Race condition (TOCTOU) between balance check and ledger entry commitment.
CWE-287: Missing authentication check when step-up MFA challenge is marked skipped.
CWE-327: Use of broken cryptographic algorithm MD5 for transaction integrity check.
CWE-918: Unvalidated merchant webhook destination allows SSRF into cloud metadata IP.
CWE-384: Session fixation during merchant portal login.
CWE-209: Detailed database connection string exposed in payment gateway exception.
CWE-601: Open redirect vulnerability in 3D Secure returnUrl parameter.
CWE-770: Unbounded memory allocation during historical velocity sliding window calculation.
God class: TransactionRecord contains 92 fields and 41 lifecycle handlers.
Hardcoded currency conversion multipliers instead of dynamic decimal lookup.
Sequential row-by-row cursor iteration over 500,000 ledger balance lines.
Redundant remote model inference call on identical transaction payload.
Empty exception catch block suppressing critical Redis connection failures.
CWE-522: Insufficiently protected API keys stored with single-round SHA-256 instead of Argon2id.

vulnerabilities.title: Cleartext Storage of PAN in Application Logs
vulnerabilities.desc: Primary account numbers logged in plaintext in payment/card_tokenizer.py line 74, violating PCI-DSS Req 3.4.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Ledger Reconciliation Search
vulnerabilities.desc: Unsanitized account_id parameter allows raw SQL execution and transaction ledger exfiltration.

vulnerabilities.title: Static Private Key Embedded in SWIFT Gateway
vulnerabilities.desc: Hardcoded RSA 2048-bit test signing key present in production codebase.

vulnerabilities.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery on Wire Approval
vulnerabilities.desc: Corporate treasury funds transfer endpoint lacks CSRF token validation.

vulnerabilities.title: Concurrent Race Condition on Account Balances
vulnerabilities.desc: Double spend possible under high concurrency due to missing database row-level lock.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Authentication in Step-Up MFA Bypass
vulnerabilities.desc: Skipping optional parameter bypasses biometric two-factor verification on wires > $10,000.

vulnerabilities.title: Use of Broken Cryptographic Algorithm MD5
vulnerabilities.desc: Transaction block hash calculation relies on MD5, vulnerable to collision attacks.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Request Forgery via Merchant Webhooks
vulnerabilities.desc: Unrestricted webhook dispatcher allows targeting AWS IMDSv2 metadata service.

vulnerabilities.title: Session Fixation in Portal Authentication
vulnerabilities.desc: Pre-auth session ID not renewed upon merchant manager privilege grant.

vulnerabilities.title: Database Connection String Leaked in API Response
vulnerabilities.desc: Internal database host, port, and username returned in HTTP 500 error stack.

reports.title: PCI-DSS Level 1 Technical Security Audit & Findings
reports.summary: RELEASE BLOCKED: 8 High vulnerabilities identified including cleartext PAN logging and missing row lock in ledger balances.

reports.title: FedNow & ISO 20022 Interbank Settlement Readiness
reports.summary: Core messaging schemas verified. Real-time gross settlement latency conforms to sub-200ms requirements.

reports.title: Quarterly Financial Ledger Invariant & Double-Entry Proof
reports.summary: Zero discrepancy identified across 14,200,000 ledger debit/credit postings. Perfect mathematical balance balance preserved.
